turns.q: My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
turns.replyTail:
Hey Bestie! Thanks for reaching out to us. I’m sorry one of your items arrived damaged 💖

Please send:

Your order number
A clear photo of everything you received
A photo of the damaged item
The name of the damaged item and a quick description of the issue

I’ll check the next steps for your claim once I have those details.

Evry Customer Specialist

turns.q: Is a damaged item handled differently from a normal return?
turns.replyTail:
accepted, but a damaged item can be reviewed under the warranty process. Please send your order number, a clear photo of everything received, a photo of the damaged item, the item name, and a short description of the issue.

Once those details are provided, the available resolution can be checked. Depending on the order’s coverage and item availability, this may be a replacement or store credit rather than a refund. You don’t need to send the item back unless you’re specifically told otherwise.

turns.q: Will I get a replacement or a refund?
turns.replyTail:
a replacement or store credit, depending on your order’s coverage and whether the item is in stock.

With standard coverage, an in-stock item may be replaced or settled with store credit.
With Package Protection or the 1 Year Warranty, store credit is the default. A replacement can be considered if you specifically request one and the item is in stock.
If the item is out of stock, store credit is issued.

Please attach your photos here and send your order number so the claim can be reviewed. 💖

turns.q: Do I have to pay anything to return the damaged item?
turns.replyTail: You don’t need to pay a return fee or mail the item back to start a damaged-item claim. Please attach the photos here and send your order number, the item name, and a short description of the damage. If a replacement is approved, you won’t need to return the original item. 💖

turns.q: How long does the replacement take?
turns.replyTail:
Thanks for getting in touch. Once a replacement is approved, it is sent by standard shipping. Most orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days, then delivery usually takes:

United States and Canada: 3–7 business days
International destinations: 14–20 business days

Expedited or overnight shipping isn’t available for replacement orders. These are estimates, and delivery time begins after the replacement ships. 💖

turns.replyTail:
g with clear photos of everything you received and each damaged item.

The resolution applies to the whole claim:

If all affected items are in stock, the claim may be handled with replacements or store credit, depending on your coverage.
If any affected item is out of stock, store credit is issued instead.

If a replacement arrives damaged too, a second replacement is not automatic and the issue needs to be reviewed before another remedy can be issued.
